component.name: Stallion
component.summary: Convert video and audio with FFmpeg
Convierte vídeo y audio con FFmpeg

description.p: Stallion is a friendly converter for video and audio. Pick a ready-made format, or make your own, and it takes care of FFmpeg for you.

ul.li: 34 formats: MP4, WebM, MKV, AV1 and HEVC with HDR, social media, editing and audio
Several formats from one file, in one go
Subtitles burned in or embedded, and audio track selection
GPU encoding with NVIDIA, Intel and AMD, with a CPU fallback
A queue with live progress and a CPU and GPU activity monitor

description.p: Stallion es un conversor de vídeo y audio amable. Elige un formato listo, o crea el tuyo, y se encarga de FFmpeg por ti.

screenshot.caption: One video converted to several formats

description.p: A full rebuild on FFmpeg with a new interface, GPU encoding, custom formats and a queue that converts one file to several formats.
